campaigns.name: The Comeback Campaign
campaigns.objective: signups — encourage users who abandoned past habit apps to try Streakly during a fresh-start moment.
campaigns.big_idea: Everyone misses a day. Real life happens. Streakly doesn’t punish you — it helps you make a comeback. This campaign normalizes missed days and positions streak repair as the smart, kind way to build habits.
campaigns.hook: Missed a day? That’s not failure. That’s life. Your streak can still survive.

sample_copy.headline: Your habit streak doesn’t have to die after one missed day.
sample_copy.body: Streakly lets you repair a missed day by doubling up within the week. No guilt, no reset, just progress. Weekly targets beat daily chains when life gets busy.
sample_copy.cta: Join the beta — habits that survive real life.

assets_needed: Short video showing streak repair in action
Social media graphics with warm, playful tone
Reddit post sharing founder’s own habit comeback story
campaigns.success_metric: Number of beta signups from campaign links
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses the brand’s vocabulary like 'streak repair' and 'survive real life', matches the encouraging tone, and avoids shame-based language.

campaigns.name: Weekly Wins, Not Daily Chains
campaigns.objective: awareness — shift the cultural narrative from unbroken streaks to sustainable weekly progress.
campaigns.big_idea: Daily streaks set you up to fail. Streakly promotes weekly targets grounded in behavior-change research. This campaign educates users on why flexibility beats rigidity in habit formation.
campaigns.hook: Why your habit app is setting you up to fail — and what to do instead.

sample_copy.headline: Forget daily streaks. Try weekly targets that fit real life.
sample_copy.body: Streakly scores your habits weekly, so one missed day doesn’t ruin everything. Based on behavior-change research, not gamified guilt. Private, simple, and kind.
sample_copy.cta: Learn how weekly wins build lasting habits.

assets_needed: LinkedIn article on the psychology of weekly vs. daily tracking
campaigns.success_metric: Media pickups or featured newsletter placements
campaigns.why_on_brand: Echoes the key message 'weekly targets, not daily guilt' and avoids words like 'grind' or 'crush your goals'.

campaigns.name: No Shame, Just Progress
campaigns.objective: community — build empathy and connection among users who’ve quit apps due to guilt.
campaigns.big_idea: Guilt kills habits. Streakly removes shame mechanics entirely. This campaign invites users to share their 'I quit because I missed one day' stories and discover a kinder alternative.
campaigns.hook: Raise your hand if you’ve deleted a habit app after missing one day.

sample_copy.headline: You’re not lazy. Your app was too harsh.
sample_copy.body: Streakly was built for people who quit. No social feed, no leaderboards, no shame. Just gentle nudges and streak repair when life happens.
sample_copy.cta: Try an app that forgives missed days.

assets_needed: Screenshot of app with no red 'X' or guilt triggers
Show HN thread linking to TestFlight
campaigns.success_metric: Number of user stories shared or upvotes on Show HN
campaigns.why_on_brand: Aligns with the brand’s 'no shame' messaging and uses empathetic, encouraging language consistent with the voice.

campaigns.name: The Anti-Habitica
campaigns.objective: awareness — differentiate Streakly from gamified, social habit apps.
campaigns.big_idea: Habitica turns habits into a game. Streakly keeps them human. This campaign contrasts Streakly’s private, forgiving approach with the pressure of avatars, penalties, and social accountability.
campaigns.hook: What if your habit app didn’t treat you like a character in a game?

sample_copy.headline: No dragons. No guilds. No shame. Just habits that fit your life.
sample_copy.body: Streakly is private by default, on-device, and built for comebacks. If Habitica stressed you out, try a tracker that rewards consistency, not perfection.
sample_copy.cta: Join the beta — no account needed.

campaigns.success_metric: Upvotes on Product Hunt or engagement on X thread
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses brand differentiators like 'private by default' and 'streak repair', avoids competitive or aggressive language, stays warm and playful.

campaigns.name: Tiny Habits, Big Comebacks
campaigns.objective: retention — re-engage beta users who’ve paused tracking.
campaigns.big_idea: Missing a day isn’t failure — it’s part of the process. This campaign sends gentle, playful nudges to inactive beta users, reminding them they can repair and restart without losing progress.
campaigns.hook: Your streak is waiting. One extra tap today and you’re back on track.

sample_copy.headline: Missed a day? That’s okay. Your streak can still survive.
sample_copy.body: Double up today and repair your streak. Streakly was made for real life — where comebacks count more than perfection.
sample_copy.cta: Tap to continue your weekly win.

campaigns.success_metric: Percentage of inactive users who resume tracking
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses the brand’s voice and vocabulary like 'comeback' and 'streak repair', maintains a warm, encouraging tone without pressure.

confidence.notes: Campaigns are tightly aligned with brand voice, messaging, and differentiators. Proof points are limited to observed data. No invented testimonials or metrics.
